name: 夫が妻の姓を選ぶとき、それぞれの声

p_07ed712929.sentence: When I accepted that our families were different, I felt much more at ease.
p_07ed712929.prev: But learning how each family does things was harder than changing my last name.
p_07ed712929.next: The next speaker is a mother.

p_224027b3ab.sentence: In a talk about last names, perhaps a person’s choice meets a parent’s feeling that they are giving something up.
p_224027b3ab.prev: A parent who respects a son’s choice said they wanted the other parents to feel at least a little thankful to their son.
p_224027b3ab.next: Along with a couple’s choice about their last name, parents may have feelings they want to share with the other parents.

p_d4ec010f33.sentence: They may care about different things.
p_d4ec010f33.prev: He and both families have their own feelings.
p_d4ec010f33.next: How can they choose something they can all accept?

p_a8e8649b99.sentence: He lives with his family at his wife’s parents’ home.
p_a8e8649b99.prev: He took his wife’s last name.
p_a8e8649b99.next: I became an adopted son in my wife’s family and took their last name.

p_6337623c8d.sentence: When he said he would change his last name too, I felt my son was moving away.
p_6337623c8d.prev: He will live near her parents’ home, far from us.

p_6f9b2bdca8.sentence: I need to let my son go, don’t I?
p_6f9b2bdca8.next: I still feel sad, but I want to accept his choice.

p_e1f4434850.sentence: If my son chose that, I would not be against it.
p_e1f4434850.prev: I think it is fine for a man to take his wife’s last name.
p_e1f4434850.next: But I cannot stop thinking about a relative.

p_be39c95a7f.sentence: But if it were my son, I would still feel bothered if his partner’s parents thought it was only natural.
p_be39c95a7f.prev: I know his mother, my aunt, was so shocked that she became ill.
p_be39c95a7f.next: I want them to feel at least a little thankful to my son.

p_6b419e60e0.sentence: They asked me again and again if I was sure.
p_6b419e60e0.prev: My wife’s parents were the ones who worried.
p_6b419e60e0.next: I was thankful that both families accepted my choice and were not upset.

p_f932b7703a.sentence: Or he may join her family as an adopted son.
p_f932b7703a.prev: A husband may choose his wife’s last name on the marriage form.
p_f932b7703a.next: He and both families have their own feelings.

p_44cd276ff5.sentence: They were not old-fashioned about it.
p_44cd276ff5.prev: My parents accepted it easily, even though my hometown is far out in the country.
p_44cd276ff5.next: My wife’s parents were the ones who worried.

p_d89972fe17.prev: The last speaker is a parent.
